messages:
maya: Quick design review — simulated traffic toggle + empty-state copy for Routing Policies editor. Attached mockups. Asking for thoughts on inline hints and keyboard discoverability.

sam: Love the toggle idea. Question: when sim is ON, does the preview run against sample traffic only, or real recent traffic? Need to be clear for customers.

maya: @sam sample traffic only — deterministic sample set, nothing sent to prod. Should we make that explicit in the tooltip?

ben: Tooltip idea: "Run preview against a deterministic sample (no real requests sent)". Shorter: "Simulated traffic — runs on a sample dataset, not live traffic". :thinking_face:

rachel: Copy variants (top to bottom preference):
```:
1) "Simulate preview: run routing rules on a deterministic sample. No live requests are affected."
2) "Preview with sample traffic — safe, repeatable, no live impact."
3) "Run rules on sample data (recommended for testing)."
```

maya: Nice. Also need keyboard + screen reader note. Toggle needs aria-pressed and visible focus ring. @ben can you add a focus state to the mock?

ben: Yep will add. Also propose a micro-animation when test starts (pulse) so people know preview is running. Might be noisy — happy to make it optional.

sam: From product POV we should surface estimated latency and sample size in the preview header. Users care about representativeness.

maya: Agreed. Suggest header: "Preview — sample 500 requests • est. 120ms per rule". Thoughts?

rachel: That feels heavy. Maybe keep the numbers on hover or a compact chip: "500 samples • 120ms" with tooltip for details.

maya: Good call. Accessibility bot reminder.

design-bot: accessibility-checklist: "Toggle must be keyboard operable, ARIA labels, contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for toggle text, announce 'Preview started' via live region." 

deploy-bot: FYI feature-flag created: routing.preview.sim_toggle -> targeting internal beta. Deploy planned Wed.

maya: Ok next steps: Ben to update mock w/ focus + animation optional flag, Rachel to finalize copy (short tooltip + expanded docs), Sam to wire up header metrics, I'll iterate on empty state visuals and add the 'Start Preview' CTA prominence. Back in 48h?

sam: SGTM

ben: On it :thumbsup:

rachel: I'll drop final copy into the doc by EOD tomorrow.

maya: thanks team :heart:
